topology_pid_handling: PID file is accepted only when /proc/PID/cmdline contains the absolute project topology script; discovery candidates receive the same check.
host_process_handling: Only exact mininet shell PIDs proven by process ancestry beneath verified project topology PIDs are signaled.
bridge_handling: Only supported s1-s4 bridge IDs are considered, and deletion requires controller tcp:127.0.0.1:6653 plus bridge-prefixed port names; uncertain ownership raises an error and fails closed.
interface_handling: Only switch-side interfaces belonging to bridges already verified and removed as project bridges are considered; no all-interface deletion.
stale_pid_handling: A stale/reused PID with a mismatching command is ignored.
signal_policy: SIGTERM first; exact verified topology PID SIGKILL only after an 8-second wait.
launcher_shutdown: Recorded backend/Ryu/frontend/topology PIDs are command-checked (and frontend cwd-checked) before SIGTERM; routine cleanup does not call mn -c.
